newsitem.title: USA: U.S. farm trade surplus $1.848 billion in August.
newsitem.headline: U.S. farm trade surplus $1.848 billion in August.

text.p: The U.S. trade surplus in agricultural commodities was $1.848 billion in August, up from a revised $1.669 billion in July, the Commerce Department said Friday.
In its monthly trade report, Commerce pegged farm exports at $4.538 billion in August, up from $4.359 billion in July. Imports were $2.690 billion, unchanged from the previous month.
The cumulative surplus in farm trade was $17.178 billion in January to August, compared with $15.110 billion in the same period last year.

In August, the value of U.S. corn exports fell to $535 million from $712 million in July. Soybean exports rose to $437 million from $388 million, and wheat exports rose to $792 million from $621 million, the department said.
Exports of meat and meat preparations were $599 million, up from $520 million in July.
Vegetable oil imports rose to $129 million in August from $106 million in July.
